features.name: total_cost_score
features.description: Sum of buying and maintenance costs, representing the overall financial burden.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous severity measure of cost, allowing the linear SVM to establish a clear margin based on affordability.

features.name: capacity_score
features.description: Sum of doors, persons, and luggage boot size, representing the overall physical capacity of the car.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates capacity metrics into a single linear projection, simplifying the feature space for the SVM.

features.name: safety_capacity_interaction
features.description: Product of safety and persons, capturing the interaction between passenger capacity and safety level.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes a non-linear interaction to the linear model, helping to separate cars that are both safe and spacious.

features.name: value_for_money
features.description: Ratio of total capacity and safety to total cost, representing the utility gained per unit of cost.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a smooth normalized score that directly correlates with overall desirability, ideal for linear margin separation.

features.name: is_high_safety_low_cost
features.description: Indicator for cars with at least medium safety and low combined cost.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a sharp decision boundary feature for the SVM to easily identify high-value configurations.

features.name: overall_quality_index
features.description: Weighted composite index balancing safety, capacity, and cost.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as an approximate linear projection of overall quality, aligning well with the linear SVM's decision function.

features.name: cost_to_safety_ratio
features.description: Ratio of total cost to safety level, indicating how much is paid per unit of safety.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights inefficient trade-offs between cost and safety, providing a continuous risk measure for the model.

features.name: family_car_suitability
features.description: Indicator for cars with adequate persons capacity, doors, and safety for family use.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a distinct binary feature that groups family-appropriate vehicles, aiding in margin construction.

features.name: luxury_proxy
features.description: Indicator for cars with high buying price, high maintenance, and high safety.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates premium vehicles into a single dimension, allowing the SVM to apply specific weights to this segment.

features.name: basic_transport_score
features.description: Sum of the minimum cost factor and safety, representing the baseline utility of the vehicle.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a robust, smooth feature that captures essential transportation value without being skewed by a single high cost.

features.name: semantic_family_appeal
features.description: Semantic judgment of the car's appeal to families, considering passenger capacity, doors, luggage space, and safety.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures nuanced, non-linear combinations of capacity and safety that formulaic features might miss, providing a smooth score for the SVM.

features.name: semantic_economic_viability
features.description: Semantic judgment of the car's economic viability, balancing buying price, maintenance cost, and basic utility.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic assessment of cost-effectiveness, offering a continuous severity measure that aligns with linear decision boundaries.
